transcript: Someone is following me near the north gate. He has a knife. I was delivering a package when he stopped me beside the parking area and demanded my phone. I moved toward the staffed entrance, but he is still behind me. I cannot tell whether anyone else is nearby. I have not checked for injuries. Please send help now.

facts.text: Caller reports a demand for their phone

explanation: The caller reports a knife threat, a demand for their phone and an ongoing pursuit toward a staffed entrance. Urgent police review is suggested; the exact site and injury status are unknown.
